scripts.build: echo "[build]" && rimraf artifacts cache && pnpm run copy-contracts && pnpm run build-v3 && pnpm run build-v4 && pnpm run build-v4-periphery
scripts.copy-contracts: echo "[copy-contracts]" && rimraf contracts && pnpm run copy-contracts-v3 && pnpm run copy-contracts-v4 && pnpm run copy-contracts-v4-periphery
scripts.copy-contracts-v4: echo "[copy-contracts-v4]" && copyfiles -u 4 "node_modules/@uniswap/v4-core/src/**/*" contracts/v4 && rimraf contracts/v4/test contracts/v4/*.sol
scripts.copy-contracts-v4-periphery: echo "[copy-contracts-v4-periphery]" && copyfiles -u 5 "node_modules/@uniswap/v4-periphery/src/interfaces/**/*" contracts/v4-periphery/interfaces && copyfiles -u 5 "node_modules/@uniswap/v4-periphery/src/libraries/PathKey.sol" contracts/v4-periphery/libraries && copyfiles -u 5 "node_modules/@uniswap/v4-periphery/src/libraries/PositionInfoLibrary.sol" contracts/v4-periphery/libraries
scripts.package-clean: echo "[package-clean]" && rimraf contracts artifacts cache dist build
scripts.package-recompile: echo "[package-recompile]" && pnpm run package-clean && pnpm run package-compile
